4 اشكدهُ He gave him of dates on their being cut, and of wheat on its being reaped. (L.) He gave him of a heap of reaped corn on the occasion of measuring, and of the bundles (حُزَم) [of corn] on the occasion of reaping: of the dial. of ElYemen. (L.) He gave him food to eat, or milk to drink, after it had been deposited in the house or tent. (L.) ―
-b2- See also 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
